signature.composition: large safe door with white wheel left and orange tag right

prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for locking a PLC tag. Draw a large solid NAVY CLOSED SAFE DOOR, square with rounded corners. On the LEFT of the door show a huge WHITE ROUND SAFE WHEEL with three thick spokes; on the RIGHT show one bold ORANGE TAG silhouette with a white hole. The square safe and wheel should dominate and remain obvious at 30x18. No padlock, shield, bars, arrow, check mark, text, numbers, shadow, or blue C shape. All art in central 70 percent of square.
